text:
nora (Docs): Drafting the sprint changelog + whatsnew microcopy. Main items: adaptive routing note, streaming API snippets, and two known issues (preview TTL and legacy anchor redirects). Need quick eyes.
diego (Product): For the banner please keep it punchy: one sentence about cost/latency tradeoff and a single line saying Dedicated unaffected.
nora (Docs): Proposal: "Adaptive routing may fall back to compatible model variants under peak load 12 lowering cost but possibly increasing tail latency. Hosted API only; Dedicated deployments unaffected." Too long?
hana (SDK): Trim a bit: "Adaptive routing can fall back to compatible variants under peak load 12 lowers cost, may affect tail latency. Hosted only." Also paste the minimal JS/Python streaming snippets that need to go in Migration.
hana (SDK): JS snippet:
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-7b', input: 'Summarize changes' });
for await (const part of stream) console.log(part.text);
```
hana (SDK): Py snippet:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='rwd-3b', input='Summarize'):
    print(chunk.text)
```
liam (Eng): quick ops notes: CDN rule for docs was fixed so public links now have a 14-day TTL by default. Publisher preview links still expire after 1 hour. Ticket ENG-2401 open to unify flows. Workaround: publish stable page or request extended preview TTL.
nora (Docs): adding known-issue: "Publisher preview links (1-hour TTL) may expire when shared externally; workaround: publish stable page or request longer TTL (ENG-2401)."
diego (Product): Also call out reranker alias deprecation so customers don't get surprised.
liam (Eng): The alias for rwd-ranker-v1 will be removed on 2026-08-01; migrate to rwd-ranker-v2 and re-run indexing (ENG-2410).
nora (Docs): added: "Reranker aliasing may return 404 after 2026-08-01; update to rwd-ranker-v2 and reindex. (ENG-2410)"
support-bot: note: Please include a short troubleshooting checklist for deprecation warnings in the KB.
nora (Docs): added Migration checklist: 1) verify SDK version (JS >= 1.4.0, Py >= 0.9.0); 2) update packages (npm/pip); 3) clear local caches and restart. Kept concise.
hana (SDK): tiny nit: the whatsnew banner in the staging build is still using the legacy helper name client.streamResponses() in the JS example 12 update to client.responses.stream().
nora (Docs): thanks, fixed in the banner. I'll open the PR after a 30-min review window. deploy-bot: PR 5138 opened by nora: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5138|view PR> :spiral_note_pad:
diego (Product): LGTM. Once merged, can we add the PR link to the release email so support and customer success can reference the snippets?
support-bot: done 12 I'll include PR 5138 in the release notes email template.
nora (Docs): merging in ~1 hour unless any other blockers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
